query: We need to add a required normalized_email column to a 90-million-row users table. Signup and login must remain available during rollout, and some rows have invalid email values. Propose the migration sequence.
expected_behavior: Uses an expand, deploy, backfill, validate, constrain sequence that keeps old and new application versions compatible during rollout
Backfills in bounded resumable batches and tracks progress instead of running one unbounded table update
Defines how invalid or missing legacy values are handled before adding the constraint, without inventing replacement addresses
Checks lock, write amplification, and replication lag risks and names a pause or rollback condition
Provides a down or forward-recovery plan that preserves data written during the transition
